description: This Java class 'EmailBusinessRulesData' serves as a data container for email business rules related to reports within the Fineract infrastructure. It includes fields such as report ID, name, type, subtype, description, and report parameters, with utility methods for instantiation and overridden 'equals' and 'hashCode' methods.
